to.shell_command: omniwmctl command focus previous || omniwmctl command switch-workspace back-and-forth

omniwmctl command set-container-primary-span -10% || omniwmctl command resize-focused shrink

osascript -e 'quit app "OmniWM"'; for _ in $(seq 50); do pgrep -xq 'OmniWM' || break; sleep 0.2; done; if pgrep -xq 'OmniWM'; then osascript -e 'display notification with title "OmniWM did not quit"'; else open -a 'OmniWM' && osascript -e 'display notification with title "restarted OmniWM"'; fi
